provenance.notes: Encoder: onnx_graph_walk of WhisperEncoder built from the real config with random init (226 nodes -> 111 ops, 18.47 GMAC for the 30 s window). Mel front end and 12-token greedy decoder: config_derived. int8 weights are a deployment assumption. Period/deadline are reasonable defaults, not measured.
